caseName: Mathiasen Tanker Industries, Inc. v. Mason
caseNameFull: Mathiasen Tanker Industries, Inc. v. Mason
attorneys: Harry E. McCoy for petitioner., Sidney H. Kelsey for respondent.
judges: Amendment, Because, Black, Constitution, Granted, Guaranteed, Right, Should, Trial

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted in this case because the petitioning shipowner here has been denied its right to trial by jury guaranteed by the Seventh Amendment to the Constitution.
